sections.theory:
Faults

In the game of badminton, if the serving team commits some fault, the service will be given to the other team, and if the team receiving the service commits a fault, the serving team will get a point. According to the new law both the service and the point will be together, and on every fault the point will be given to the opposing team.

The faults are as follows.

While serving, the shuttle is higher than the waist of the player.

After the service the shuttle goes into the wrong court.

The shuttle passes through or under the net.

The shuttle falls outside the boundaries of the court.

The shuttle touches the ceiling or the surrounding walls.

It touches the body or uniform of the player.

It touches some thing outside or near the court.

The shuttle comes to rest on the racket.

The player plays the shuttle twice.

Deliberately delaying in serving.

The shuttle is played before it crosses the net.

The shuttle gets stuck in the net.

The server or his partner feints the opponent.

During the game the body or racket touches the net.

شٹل نیٹ کے اندر سے یا نیچے سے گزرے۔

شٹل کورٹ کے حدود سے باہر گرے۔

شٹل چھت یا اطراف کی دیواروں کو ٹچ کرے۔
